pos.description: Only this part of speech: noun, verb, adjective or adverb.

safe.description: Best-effort family-friendly filter (default false). Drops senses WordNet tags as vulgar, derogatory, slur or slang, senses whose definitions describe sexual, excretory or illegal-drug meanings, and a list of profane and slur words, everywhere in the answer. Not a guarantee;

word.description: A word or phrase (up to 64 characters; "ice cream", "run away"). Inflected forms are matched to their base form: ran → run, mice → mouse, dogs → dog.
